Count-in 4 beats → hop to the note's string → strum as the LED reaches Punkman. 3 rounds change the pattern and the tempo (80→100 BPM).

PERFECT ±90 ms · GREAT ±160 ms · GOOD ±240 ms. Late, early or the wrong string −1 ♥ · a root note (pink LED) −2 ♥ · a round with no miss heals +1 ♥.

Ultimate: every hit fills OVERDRIVE. At 100% play the chromatic run on string 1 — frets 1 2 3 4, keys 1 2 3 4 in order — and RGB Overdrive hits Synth Drake for −20. A wrong fret restarts the run; the meter keeps its charge.

Make it yours

Note guide plays each note at its real pitch on its beat, so you hear the scale while you run it. Auto run lets Punkman play the scale himself so you can watch every effect; auto runs are not saved. Pressing a note name once plays it in every mode (A–G, then → for a sharp or ← for a flat: G# is G → or A ←) — no Space needed. Keys: Notes + strings also lets you hop strings with W/S and strum with J, X or Space, guitar style.
